note: The labels of the rules a realm obeys (rules_l_english.yml) and the text of the 19 game rules ZIN keeps. The kept rules already carry ZIN keys written by modules/vanilla_removal.mjs (ZIN_RULE_*, common/game_rules/00_game_rules.txt), so the vanilla game_rules keys are unreachable and only the engine labels below are swept (docs/specs/07_interface/05_text_sweep.md family rules).

lit.CAN_ACCESS_MARKET: Can use the {international_market} (§Y{puppet:p}§! and §Y{overlord:p}§! can always use each other's fairs)
lit.CAN_BOOST_OTHER_IDEOLOGIES: Can raise the popularity of other alignments
lit.CAN_BOOST_OWN_IDEOLOGY: Can raise the popularity of its own party in other realms
lit.CAN_DECLARE_WAR_ON_SAME_IDEOLOGY: Can build a claim against a realm of the same alignment and declare war on it
lit.CAN_DECLARE_WAR_WITHOUT_WARGOAL_WHEN_IN_: Can declare war on a neighbour without a cause of war while at war with a great power
lit.CAN_FORCE_GOVERNMENT: Can force the {government:lc} of another realm to take on the same alignment
lit.CAN_GUARANTEE_OTHER_IDEOLOGIES: Can give a {guarantee:lc} to realms of other alignments
lit.CAN_JOIN_FACTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED_DIPLOMACY: $COUNTRY|H$ is not allowed to join a {faction:lc}
lit.CAN_ONLY_JUSTIFY_WAR_ON_THREAT_COUNTRY: Can build a claim only against a realm that has added to {world_tension}
